credit_metrics.text: EBITDA fell by {{ebitda.change@FY2025}} to {{ebitda@FY2025}} and operating profit by {{operating_profit.change@FY2025}} to {{operating_profit@FY2025}}, with higher personnel expenses and the write-offs on the abandoned runway project weighing on the result.
Total debt was broadly unchanged at {{total_debt@FY2025}}, so gross leverage held at {{gross_leverage@FY2025}}, below the peer median of {{gross_leverage.peer_median@2025}}.
FFO fell by {{ffo.change@FY2025}} to {{ffo@FY2025}}, and free cash flow dropped by {{fcf.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf@FY2025}} as capital spending absorbed more of the cash generated.
Profit for the year fell by {{profit.change@FY2025}} to {{profit@FY2025}}, reflecting the one-off items booked in the period.

liquidity_funding.text: Debt is minimal for the group, with total debt of {{total_debt@FY2025}} against EBITDA of {{ebitda@FY2025}}, so refinancing risk is limited.
Free cash flow of {{fcf@FY2025}} remains positive after capex intensity of {{capex_intensity@FY2025}}, which supports internal funding of the investment programme.
Disclosure on undrawn committed facilities and customer prepayments is not available for the year, so the liquidity buffer cannot be sized from the reported figures.

peer_positioning.text: Gross leverage of {{gross_leverage@FY2025}} is the lowest of the airport peers ({{gross_leverage.peer_rank@2025}}), well below the peer median of {{gross_leverage.peer_median@2025}}.
On EBITDA margin the company sits in the middle of the group at {{ebitda_margin@FY2025}} ({{ebitda_margin.peer_rank@2025}}).
Capex intensity of {{capex_intensity@FY2025}} is above the peer median of {{capex_intensity.peer_median@2025}}, the weaker side of the comparison.

watch_items.text: Cash generation: FFO fell by {{ffo.change@FY2025}} to {{ffo@FY2025}} and free cash flow by {{fcf.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf@FY2025}}, so the buffer against the investment programme is thinner.
Investment: capex intensity rose by {{capex_intensity.change@FY2025}} to {{capex_intensity@FY2025}}, above the peer median of {{capex_intensity.peer_median@2025}}.
Margins: the EBITDA margin narrowed by {{ebitda_margin.change@FY2025}} to {{ebitda_margin@FY2025}}, in line with the peer median but weaker than the prior year.
Cost base: personnel expenses rose on collective wage increases and additions to personnel provisions, and environmental payments to neighbouring municipalities added a further one-off charge.
